title: Beira Alta
intro: Beira Alta is a historic province of the Central region of Portugal. The chief cities/district capitals are Guarda and Viseu.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html: Beira Alta is a historic province of the Central region of Portugal. The chief cities/district capitals are Guarda and Viseu.

sections.title: Cities
sections.html:
• Almeida — municipality containing the important border town of Vilar Formoso
  • Gouveia — take the path to the highest geographical point of continental Portugal, with astonishing views over the valley
  • Guarda — its medieval cathedral was built in the Gothic and Manueline styles
  • Mangualde — inland city with an artificial sandy beach
  • Moimenta da Beira — famous for the production of wine and apples
  • Oliveira do Hospital — city with ancient civilization sights
  • Pinhel — it has one of the more important castles along the Côa River Valley
  • Sabugal — city along the River Côa with a Gothic castle
  • Santa Comba Dão — riverside city
  • Sernancelhe — with a 12th-century church
  • Viseu — a charming hilltop city with a fine historic quarter, its Romanesque and Gothic cathedral is one of the finest in Portugal

sections.title: Other destinations
sections.html: • Côa Valley — an open-air Paleolithic archaeological site with thousands of engraved rock drawings of horses, bovines and other animals, human and abstract figures, dated from 22,000 to 10,000 years BCE

sections.title: Understand
sections.html:
Beira Alta (BAY-ruh AHL-tuh, /ˈbɐj.ɾɐ ˈaɫ.tɐ/)

Mostly rural, except for Guarda & Viseu. Beautiful mountains (Serra da Estrela, Caramulo, Marofa). Tranquil rivers of (Mondego, Coa, Vouga, Paiva, Dao), gorgeous meadows, pinewood forest and castles along Terras de Riba-Coa (Pinhel, Almeida, Figueira de Castelo Rodrigo (cattle and almond trees) and Sabugal area).

sections.title: Get in
sections.html: Train from Vilar Formoso- Guarda-Pampilhosa-Coimbra. Motorway A25 (Viseu-Aveiro-Guarda).

sections.title: See
sections.html:
Cathedral and museums in Viseu: Museu Gao Vasco.

  • Guarda (Se/cathedral), castle of Pinhel & Sabugal Castle.

sections.title: Do
sections.html:
• São Pedro do Sul (spa/town)/Vouga valley.
  • Parque arqueologico do vale do Coa rupestre - pre-historic art
  • Ski during winter in Estrela Mountain, Loriga, Seia, Torre.

sections.title: Stay safe
sections.html: Considered one of the safest in Portugal.

sections.title: Go next
sections.html:
• Coimbra
  • Aveiro
  • Porto
  • Lamego — historic city, near Douro river
  • Monsanto — in Beira Baixa
  • Salamanca, Spain
